world.title: Who was the female pilot in the Learjet 60 crash? Intense social media speculation over Alexandra Dudgeon, Nathalia Filguerias as identity kept under wraps
world.summary: The identity of the female pilot involved in the Learjet 60 crash in Florida remains undisclosed. The aircraft went down, resulting in the deaths of all nine individuals on board. Speculation on social media surrounds Alexandra Dudgeon and Nathalia Filguerias, but authorities have not confirmed any names. Investigations continue as the community seeks answers regarding the tragedy.

world.title: Palantir’s Alex Karp is now a forest owner: Buys 37,000 acres in Sweden for reported $22 million; why hunters can no longer enter it
world.summary: Palantir CEO Alex Karp has acquired 15,000 hectares (37,000 acres) of forest in Härjedalen, Sweden, for approximately $22 million through his newly established company, Cladonia Skog AB. Following the purchase, hunting access to the land has been restricted, impacting local hunters. The acquisition highlights Karp's investment in natural resources and land management in Sweden.

world.title: A California accountant told investors their money would fund backyard homes, but no homes were built and more than $8.2 million vanished in risky trading; he has now been sentenced to 63 months in pr
world.summary: A California accountant, 30, was sentenced to 63 months in prison for defrauding investors of over $8.2 million. He misled them into believing their funds would be used to construct backyard homes, but no homes were built. The U.S. District Judge also ordered him to forfeit the $8.2 million involved in the risky trading activities.

business.title: Reddit Stock Drops Over 33% After Declining Google Search Traffic
business.summary: Reddit's stock fell 36% in the past week following CEO Steve Huffman's confirmation of declining Google Search traffic for the platform. This drop reflects concerns within the industry, as many SEO experts anticipated this trend. The decrease in traffic may impact Reddit's overall user engagement and revenue, prompting scrutiny from investors and analysts regarding the company's future performance.

business.title: Chinese Plane That Released Mysterious Objects Above US Caught On Camera
business.summary: A photograph of China's secretive robotic space plane, Shenlong, has been released by a US intelligence agency. The image shows Shenlong docked with another satellite, its solar panels deployed and payload door open. The plane, also known as "divine dragon," has been operational for six years and has garnered attention for its mysterious activities above the US.

business.title: TVS October 2026 Sales: 28% YoY Growth, 6.71 Lakh Units
business.summary: TVS Motor Company reported total sales of 671,000 units in October 2026, marking a 28% year-over-year growth. The electric two-wheeler segment achieved record sales of 71,382 units, reflecting a significant 120% increase compared to the previous year. This performance highlights the company's strong position in the market and the growing demand for electric vehicles.

technology.title: Red Dead Redemption 2 players can claim free outfits, gold bars and Halloween rewards before November 4 deadline
technology.summary: Rockstar Games has launched limited-time rewards in Red Dead Online for its Halloween event, allowing players to claim free outfits, gold bars, and other bonuses until November 4. The event features boosted payouts but does not include a free download of the full Red Dead Redemption 2 game. Players are encouraged to participate before the deadline.

technology.title: Touchscreen MacBook Pro, iPad Mini OLED and 4 more: Apple devices to arrive in India on Nov 6
technology.summary: Apple is set to launch a new lineup of devices in India on November 6, including OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro models, a new iPad mini, and an upgraded iMac. Pre-orders for these products began on October 28. The touchscreen MacBooks will be available shortly after the initial release. Details on features and pricing have also been revealed.

technology.title: Vivo X500 Ultra Leak Hints at 200MP Telephoto; Vivo X500s Could Feature a 68MP Selfie Camera
technology.summary: The Vivo X500 Ultra is expected to feature a flagship camera setup, including a 200MP telephoto camera, dual 50MP rear sensors, and a 50MP selfie camera. It will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip. Additionally, the Vivo X500s may include a 68MP selfie camera, enhancing its photographic capabilities. Launch details remain unconfirmed.

sports.title: BCCI extends IPL retention deadline to November 17
sports.summary: The BCCI has extended the IPL player retention deadline to November 17, moving it from the original date of November 15. This decision accommodates the India-New Zealand ODI scheduled for November 15. The board communicated this change to the franchises on November 2, allowing them two additional days to finalize their player retention lists for the upcoming season.

sports.title: History maker! Alexander Zverev becomes oldest first-time world No. 1 in 52 years, joins Boris Becker in elite German club
sports.summary: Alexander Zverev has achieved a significant milestone by becoming the world No. 1 in men's tennis for the first time in his career at age 29. This accomplishment makes him the oldest first-time world No. 1 in 52 years. Zverev joins Boris Becker in an elite group of German players who have reached this prestigious ranking.

sports.title: 2026 F1 Championships - Standings after the Mexican Grand Prix in Mexico City
sports.summary: Kimi Antonelli has been crowned the 2026 Formula 1 World Champion following the Mexican Grand Prix in Mexico City. The Italian driver, representing Mercedes, secured the title with a total of 380 points. The standings reflect his dominance throughout the season, marking a significant achievement in his racing career. The championship continues to attract global attention and excitement.

health.title: Manipal Hospitals Promotes BE FAST Approach To Stroke Detection
health.summary: Manipal Hospitals in Kolkata organized a stroke awareness program on October 29, 2026, in observance of World Stroke Day. The event promoted the BE FAST approach for early stroke detection and prevention, emphasizing the importance of timely medical intervention to reduce disability. The initiative aims to raise awareness about stroke risks and encourage prompt responses to symptoms.

health.title: Mumbai's Qure.ai Revolutionizes Global Healthcare with AI Tools for TB, Cancer, and Heart Disease Diagnosis
health.summary: Mumbai's Qure.ai is transforming global healthcare with its AI-powered diagnostic tools for tuberculosis, lung cancer, and heart disease. The startup's software has been evaluated by the World Health Organization for its effectiveness in automated chest X-ray screening for TB. Qure.ai's innovations are impacting millions of patients across more than 100 countries, enhancing early detection and treatment options.

health.title: Exactly how long you should wait after a meal before going for a walk, according to a naturopath
health.summary: Experts recommend taking a digestive walk after meals to support digestion. While the timing can vary, waiting about 10 to 30 minutes post-meal is generally advised. This practice helps stimulate digestive processes and can enhance overall well-being. Incorporating walks into daily routines may counteract the modern habit of eating on the go and promote healthier digestion.

science.title: NASA Seeks Private Companies to Extend Hubble's Mission • Mezha
science.summary: NASA is seeking private companies to assist in extending the Hubble Space Telescope's mission, which may end with its reentry into Earth's atmosphere around 2033-2034. The agency aims to explore commercial options for boosting, servicing, or safely retiring the telescope. Without intervention, Hubble's operational life is limited, prompting this initiative to ensure its continued functionality.

science.title: NASA Spacecraft Becomes First To Enter Jupiter's Trojan Asteroid Region
science.summary: NASA's Lucy spacecraft has made history as the first to enter the region of Jupiter's Trojan asteroids, after traveling over 2.2 billion miles since its launch on October 16, 2021. Following its encounter with the asteroid Eurybates, Lucy will continue its mission to study additional Trojan asteroids, providing valuable insights into the early solar system.

science.title: NIO leads national effort to track El Niño impact on coral reefs
science.summary: CSIR-National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR-NIO) in Goa is spearheading a national initiative involving 23 institutions to monitor coral bleaching and evaluate the effects of El Niño and marine heatwaves on India's coral reefs. This collaborative effort aims to enhance understanding and guide conservation strategies for the country's coral reef ecosystems, addressing the challenges posed by climate change.

entertainment.title: Kareena Kapoor teases reunion with Shah Rukh Khan in King with dance-themed photo, calls him ‘forever ruler of the kingdom’
entertainment.summary: Kareena Kapoor shared a dance-themed photo teasing her reunion with Shah Rukh Khan in the film "King." Her post followed the release of the first song, "Tu Mil Jaaye," featuring Khan and Deepika Padukone on November 2. Kapoor referred to Khan as the "forever ruler of the kingdom," generating excitement among fans for their collaboration.

entertainment.title: Shafaq Naaz Hits Back After Severe Trolling For Celebrating Karwa Chauth: 'My Husband Is Muslim And...'
entertainment.summary: Shafaq Naaz addressed backlash regarding her Karwa Chauth celebrations, stating her husband is Muslim. She emphasized her respect for all religions and cultures, defending her choice to celebrate the festival. Naaz faced significant trolling after sharing photos with her husband during the occasion, prompting her to clarify her stance on religious diversity and personal beliefs.

entertainment.title: How To Enable Apple's Crash Detection
entertainment.summary: A fatal road accident in Jalandhar, Punjab, involving singer Yo Yo Honey Singh's nephew, has drawn attention to Apple's Crash Detection feature. This technology automatically alerts emergency services and designated contacts during severe accidents. The incident underscores the potential life-saving capabilities of the feature, emphasizing its importance in providing timely assistance in critical situations on the road.
